title: The Gilded Oath Revisited
author: Ansel Thornbury
blurb: Ada Coldharbour, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
